Of the six MI cohort issuers, only **MGIC (MTG)** reported an Item 5.02 board/executive change in 2024:

| Issuer | 8-K Item 5.02 Disclosure in 2024 |
|---|---|
| **MGIC (MTG)** | Appointed **Michael Thompson** to the Board of Directors (8-K filed Jan 31, 2024) |
| **Arch Capital (ACGL)** | None disclosed |
| **Enact Holdings (ACT)** | None disclosed |
| **Essent Group (ESNT)** | None disclosed |
| **NMI Holdings (NMIH)** | None disclosed |
| **Radian Group (RDN)** | None disclosed |

The remaining five issuers' 2024 8-K filings contained only earnings releases, dividend declarations, and capital actions — no director appointments, departures, officer changes, or management restructurings under Item 5.02.
